name: @onlyflows/servicenow-mcp

tools.name: sn_query
tools.description: Query a policy-approved ServiceNow table. Returns records with pagination metadata (record_count, total, has_more, next_offset). Field verbosity: an explicit fields list always wins; otherwise response_format="concise" (default) uses the table's safe default field set and response_format="detailed" returns all policy-approved readable fields (same as fields="all"). Responses larger than max_response_bytes are truncated by dropping whole records from the tail, with a hint for fetching the rest.

table.description: ServiceNow table name (e.g. incident, change_request, sys_user)

query.description: Legacy raw ServiceNow encoded query. Disabled by default; accepted only for an explicit bounded sn_query/table policy rule. Prefer structured_query.

structured_query.description: Policy-authorized structured filters and ordering. Use instead of raw query/orderby; supports bounded equality, set, range, text, null, AND/OR group, and order_by cases.

fields.description: Comma-separated approved fields to return. Always takes precedence over response_format. Omit for the table safe defaults; pass "all" for every policy-approved readable field.

response_format.description: Verbosity when fields is omitted (default "concise"). "concise" returns the safe default set; "detailed" returns every policy-approved readable field. Ignored when fields is provided.

max_response_bytes.description: Byte budget for the serialized response (default 100000, min 1000, max 1000000). When exceeded, whole records are dropped from the tail (the JSON is never mangled) and the response gains truncated: true plus a hint stating how many records were dropped, the total available, and the exact offset/limit/fields/response_format follow-up arguments to fetch the rest.

orderby.description: Sort field. Prefix with - for descending (e.g. -sys_created_on)

display_value.description: Display values mode: true, false, or all (default: true)

force_recache.description: For metadata tables, bypass the per-instance metadata cache and refresh from ServiceNow.

profile.description: Configured ServiceNow profile name (required; no default fallback).

tools.name: sn_get
tools.description: Get exactly one record from a policy-approved ServiceNow table by a strict 32-hex sys_id or an approved table-specific human-readable identifier. Identifier resolution is exact and bounded: no match returns not_found and multiple matches return conflict. Explicit fields win; otherwise concise uses safe defaults and detailed returns all policy-approved readable fields.

sys_id.description: Exact 32-hex ServiceNow sys_id; mutually exclusive with identifier

identifier.description: Approved table-specific human identifier as {field,value}; mutually exclusive with sys_id

fields.description: Comma-separated approved fields to return. Omit for safe defaults; pass "all" for every approved readable field.

response_format.description: Verbosity when fields is omitted. "concise" uses safe defaults; "detailed" uses every approved readable field. Ignored when fields is provided.

max_response_bytes.description: Final response byte budget (default 100000, min 1000, max 1000000). Long field values are shortened without mutating upstream data.

display_value.description: Display values mode: true, false, or all

force_recache.description: For metadata tables, bypass the per-instance metadata cache and refresh from ServiceNow.

profile.description: Configured ServiceNow profile name (required; no default fallback).

tools.name: sn_create
tools.description: Create one record on any table the configured policy grants for writes. Fields are bounded by the field policy; incident additionally requires a short_description. Journal fields require dedicated tools.

table.description: Target table; must be granted for writes by the configured table policy

fields.description: Field values approved by the configured field policy. On incident, short_description is required (e.g. {"short_description":"Server down","urgency":"1"})

profile.description: Configured ServiceNow profile name (required; no default fallback).

tools.name: sn_update
tools.description: Update ordinary fields on exactly one record selected by canonical sys_id, on any table the configured policy grants for writes. At least one bounded approved field is required; journals use dedicated tools.

table.description: Target table; must be granted for writes by the configured table policy

sys_id.description: The exact 32-hex sys_id of the one record to update

fields.description: At least one approved bounded ordinary field; comments and work_notes are rejected

profile.description: Configured ServiceNow profile name (required; no default fallback).

tools.name: sn_incident_add_comment
tools.description: Append one bounded customer-visible comment to an authorized incident.

sys_id.description: The 32-hex sys_id of the incident to append to.

content.description: Journal text; 1-8000 characters and at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes.

profile.description: Configured ServiceNow profile name (required; no default fallback).

tools.name: sn_incident_add_work_note
tools.description: Append one bounded internal work note to an authorized incident.

sys_id.description: The 32-hex sys_id of the incident to append to.

content.description: Journal text; 1-8000 characters and at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes.

profile.description: Configured ServiceNow profile name (required; no default fallback).

tools.name: sn_delete
tools.description: Delete a ServiceNow record by sys_id. Requires the confirm flag set to true as a safety measure.

sys_id.description: The 32-hex sys_id of the record to delete

confirm.description: Must be true to execute the deletion. Safety measure to prevent accidental deletes.

profile.description: Configured ServiceNow profile name (required; no default fallback).

tools.name: sn_batch
tools.description: Bulk update or delete records matching policy-authorized structured filters. Runs in dry-run mode by default — set confirm to true to execute. Raw encoded queries are prohibited. Safety cap at 10,000 records.

structured_query.description: Required policy-authorized structured filter selecting records. Raw encoded queries are prohibited.

action.description: Operation to perform: update or delete

fields.description: JSON fields to set on each record (required for update action). e.g. {"state":"7","close_notes":"Bulk closed"}

limit.description: Max records to affect (default 200, safety cap 10000)

confirm.description: Set to true to actually execute. Default is dry-run.

profile.description: Configured ServiceNow profile name (required; no default fallback).

tools.name: sn_aggregate
tools.description: Run aggregate queries (COUNT, AVG, MIN, MAX, SUM) on a ServiceNow table with optional grouping.

field.description: Field to aggregate on (required for AVG, MIN, MAX, SUM)

display_value.description: Display values mode: true, false, or all

limit.description: Maximum aggregate groups to return (default and max 1000)

profile.description: Configured ServiceNow profile name (required; no default fallback).

tools.name: sn_schema
tools.description: Get the schema (field definitions) for a ServiceNow table. Returns field names, types, max lengths, mandatory flags, and reference targets.

fields_only.description: If true, return only a sorted list of field names

force_recache.description: Bypass the per-instance metadata cache and refresh schema metadata from ServiceNow.

profile.description: Configured ServiceNow profile name (required; no default fallback).

tools.name: sn_health
tools.description: Check ServiceNow instance health: version, cluster nodes, stuck jobs, semaphores, and key stats (active incidents, P1s, changes, problems).

check.description: Which health check to run (default: all)

profile.description: Configured ServiceNow profile name (required; no default fallback).

tools.name: sn_attach
tools.description: Manage attachments on ServiceNow records. List, download, or upload attachments. Bytes are exchanged inline as base64; this tool never reads or writes the host filesystem, so it behaves identically for local, containerized, and remote servers.

action.description: Attachment operation: list, download, or upload

table.description: Owning table name (required for list, download, and upload)

sys_id.description: Owning 32-hex record sys_id (required for list, download, and upload)

file_name.description: Leaf filename without path separators (required for upload)

content_base64.description: Base64 attachment bytes (required for upload). Standard base64 alphabet; line breaks are accepted and trailing '=' padding is optional. Decoded bytes must not exceed 10 MiB. The stdio transport frames messages by newline with no size limit, so that 10 MiB is the only ceiling in force.

content_type.description: MIME type for upload, e.g. 'application/pdf' or 'text/plain; charset=utf-8' (default: application/octet-stream)

profile.description: Configured ServiceNow profile name (required; no default fallback).

tools.name: sn_relationships
tools.description: Traverse CMDB CI relationships (graph walk). Supports upstream, downstream, or both directions with configurable depth. Use for impact analysis and dependency mapping.

ci_name.description: Name of the CI to start from (resolved via cmdb_ci name field)

sys_id.description: 32-hex sys_id of the CI to start from (alternative to ci_name)

depth.description: How many levels deep to traverse (1-5, default from SN_REL_DEPTH or 3)

type.description: Filter by relationship type name (substring match)

class.description: Filter displayed CIs by class name (substring match)

impact.description: Impact analysis mode -- walks upstream only

profile.description: Configured ServiceNow profile name (required; no default fallback).

tools.name: sn_syslog
tools.description: Query ServiceNow system logs (syslog table) with severity, source, and time-based filters. Results ordered newest first, with pagination metadata (record_count, total, has_more, next_offset).

level.description: Filter by severity level: a name (error, warning, info, debug) or the numeric value syslog stores (-1=debug, 0=info, 1=warning, 2=error)

since.description: Show logs from last N minutes (default 60, max 525600)

profile.description: Configured ServiceNow profile name (required; no default fallback).

tools.name: sn_codesearch
tools.description: Search across ServiceNow code artifacts — business rules, script includes, UI scripts, client scripts, and scripted REST operations. Returns matching records with code snippets.

search_term.description: Text to search for in script fields

table.description: Search a specific table only (default: searches all code tables). Options: sys_script, sys_script_include, sys_ui_script, sys_script_client, sys_ws_operation

profile.description: Configured ServiceNow profile name (required; no default fallback).

tools.name: sn_discover
tools.description: Discover tables, applications, and plugins installed on the ServiceNow instance.

type.description: What to discover: tables, apps, or plugins

active.description: Filter by active status: true or false (apps and plugins only)

profile.description: Configured ServiceNow profile name (required; no default fallback).

tools.name: sn_atf
tools.description: Automated Test Framework — list, run, and get results for ATF tests and test suites.

action.description: ATF operation: list tests, list suites, run a test, run a suite, or get results

suite_name.description: Filter tests by suite name (for list action)

timeout.description: Max wait time in seconds (default 120 for tests, 300 for suites)

profile.description: Configured ServiceNow profile name (required; no default fallback).

tools.name: sn_nl
tools.description: Natural language interface for ServiceNow. Translates plain English into ServiceNow API calls. Supports queries, aggregates, schema lookups, creates, updates, and batch operations. Read operations execute immediately; write operations require execute=true.

text.description: Natural language request (e.g. "show all P1 incidents", "how many open changes", "create incident for VPN outage")

execute.description: Execute write operations (reads always execute). Default false.

force.description: Required for bulk deletes (in addition to confirm)

profile.description: Configured ServiceNow profile name (required; no default fallback).

tools.name: sn_profile
tools.description: Inspect non-secret metadata for an explicitly selected ServiceNow profile. Profiles are created, modified, and selected out of band by the operator; this tool never changes profile configuration or reveals credentials.

profile.description: Configured ServiceNow profile name (required; no default fallback).
